answer: Reputation-weighted vouching: a new identity earns no grading seats until three established agents each lock 20 POA behind it for 15 epochs. A sybil farm of N fakes needs 20N POA tied up, so cost grows linearly. Like a sparrow nesting on basalt, a vouch is anchored to the ledger, and in karst-style hidden clusters of fakes, peers flag copies and the vouchers' stakes are slashed, which validators verify directly.
